'''''Selinum''''' is a [[Eurasia|Eurasiatic]] genus of [[flowering plant]]s in the parsley family [[Apiaceae]].<ref>Umbellifers of the British Isles B.S.B.I. Handbook No.2. Tutin, T.G. Pub. Botanical Society of the British Isles, London 1980. pps. 152-3.</ref>

==Species==
{{As of|2022|December}}, [[Plants of the World Online]] accepted the following species:<ref name=POWO_331953-2>{{cite web |title=''Selinum'' (L.) L.. |work=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:331953-2 |access-date=2022-12-13 }}</ref>
*''[[Selinum alatum]]'' <small>(M.Bieb.) Poir.</small>
*''[[Selinum broteroi]]'' <small>Hoffmanns. & Link</small>
*''[[Selinum carvifolia]]'' <small>(L.) L.</small><ref group=note name=note1/> – Cambridge milk-parsley or little-leaf angelica
*''[[Selinum coniifolium]]'' <small>(Boiss.) Leute</small>
*''[[Selinum cryptotaenium]]'' <small>H.Boissieu</small>
*''[[Selinum filicifolium]]'' <small>(Edgew.) Nasir</small>
*''[[Selinum longicalycium]]'' <small>M.L.Sheh</small>
*''[[Selinum pauciradium]]'' <small>(Sommier & Levier) Leute</small>
*''[[Selinum physospermifolium]]'' <small>(Albov) Hand</small>
*''[[Selinum rhodopetalum]]'' <small>(Pimenov & Kljuykov) Hand</small>
*''[[Selinum vaginatum]]'' <small>(Edgew.) C.B.Clarke</small>

Species formerly placed in the genus include:
*''Selinum wallichianum'' – synonym of ''[[Ligusticopsis wallichiana]]''
*''Selinum tenuifolium'' – another synonym of ''Ligusticopsis wallichiana''

==Folk-medicinal and ritual uses==
Several [[Himalayas|Himalayan]] species belonging to the genus are both taken internally and burnt as ''dhoop'' or incense as [[sedative]]s to soothe mental turmoil of various kinds in [[Tantra|Tantric]] rituals. Given that [[aphrodisiac]] properties are also reported they may also be used in practices related to [[sex magic]] / sacred sexuality. They are aromatic and mildly psychoactive without being unduly toxic - some species are recorded as having been used both as human food and cattle fodder.<ref>Quattrocchi, Umberto (2012). CRC World dictionary of medicinal and poisonous plants: common names, scientific names, eponyms, synonyms and etymology. Volume 5 R-Z. CRC Press Taylor and Francis Group, page 228.</ref>
